original_post_text:
901 players showed up for the First Lone Star Ring at TCH Austin. $297,330 on the line. WSOP Circuit, in Texas, for the first time ever.

Between everything this state has been through with poker over the last few months, WSOP landing here means something. I'm making the drive tomorrow morning.🤷🏾‍♂️

#WSOP #WSOPCircuit #LoneStarRing #TexasPoker #TCH #TheShamReport
expanded_title: 901 Players and $297,330 on the Line: WSOP Circuit Lands in Texas for the First Time at TCH Austin
expanded_deck: The first Lone Star Ring event of the inaugural WSOP Circuit series at Texas Card House Austin drew an insane 901-entry turnout and a $297,330 prize pool — and I'm making the drive down I-35.
expanded_body:
Originally posted April 24, 2026.

These numbers are pretty insane: 901 players showed up for the first Lone Star Ring event at Texas Card House Austin, putting $297,330 on the line as the World Series of Poker Circuit landed in Texas for the first time ever.

Between everything this state has been through with poker over the last few months, seeing the WSOP Circuit finally plant its flag in Austin means something for the entire Texas poker community.

I'm making the drive down tomorrow morning to get in the mix.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
